title: stelechocarpus expansus
intro: Stelechocarpus expansus, commonly known as the Mamoncillo, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Stelechocarpus expansus include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its antiseptic properties make it useful in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Stelechocarpus expansus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
